ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Type, 'Customer Non-Standard Payment (A/R) Terms'), OR( ISBLANK(TEXT(Primary_Product_Segment__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(Primary_Product_Division__c)), ISBLANK(Annual_Sales_at_Account_Name__c) ) )
